get.description: Telegram widget callback; associates and revalidates the login session that created the flow via a one-time flow_token. Always returns 302 to /oauth/telegram: success carries telegram_bind=success, failure carries telegram_bind=error, flow_token and stable error_code (TELEGRAM_BIND_DISABLED, TELEGRAM_BIND_INVALID_REQUEST, TELEGRAM_BIND_FLOW_INVALID, TELEGRAM_BIND_SESSION_INVALID, TELEGRAM_BIND_ALREADY_BOUND, TELEGRAM_BIND_USER_DELETED, TELEGRAM_BIND_USER_DISABLED or TELEGRAM_BIND_INTERNAL_ERROR), the underlying error text will not be transparently transmitted.

200.description: When the creation is successful, the ID of the newly created channel is returned; if the business fails, HTTP 200 is still used, success is false and no data is returned.

data.description: It is only returned if the creation is successful and does not include channel credentials.

ids.description: The IDs of the actually newly created channels this time are arranged in the order of creation. single and multi_to_single can create at most one channel, and batch can create multiple channels; [] when no channel is created after filtering by existing rules.

id.description: It is returned only if a new channel happens to be created this time, which is the same as ids[0].

results.description: Correspondence between the original input and the new channel; returned in the order of input, excluding Key. Inputs filtered by existing rules return no entries; [] when no channel is created. Multiple inputs of multi_to_single will correspond to the same channel_id.

input_index.description: Original input position starting from 0. The entire channel.key of single (including multi-line JSON) is input 0; batch/multi_to_single common Key and Vertex API Key use original newline separation positions; Vertex service account JSON uses original array subscripts. The subscript retains the position occupied by filter empty items and is not renumbered.

channel_id.description: This input corresponds to the newly created channel ID.

batch.summary: Create new channels in batches (original items 0 and 2 are empty and filtered)

empty.summary: No channel is created after batch filtering empty keys

multi_to_single.summary: Multiple inputs are combined into one channel (original item 1 is empty and filtered)

base_url.description: Upstream base address. When editing the preview, an explicit empty string means clearing the saved value. If omitted, the saved value will be used; the relative upstream path requires a non-empty complete base address.

type.description: Channel type. Advanced custom channels are 58.

key.description: API key to use for new channel preview. Ignore this field when providing a channel_id and use the channel's saved single-key or multi-key configuration on the server side.

channel_id.description: Optional saved channel ID. Used to preview unsaved advanced custom configurations without returning keys to the front end.

advanced_custom.description: Optional advanced custom configuration JSON string. Required when creating a new advanced custom channel; overwrite the saved configuration when editing the preview, if omitted, the saved configuration will be used. Model discovery only supports explicit /v1/models routes and OpenAI data[].id responses.

header_override.description: Optional global request header override JSON string. Overwrite the saved value when editing the preview. An explicit empty string means clearing it. If it is omitted, it will be used.

proxy.description: Optional network proxy. Overwrite the saved value when editing the preview. An explicit empty string means clearing it. If it is omitted, it will be used.
